title: H221 scaffold — Drift Regime + Short-Term Reversal signal
rationale: arXiv:2511.12490 'Discovery of a 13-Sharpe OOS Factor: Drift Regimes Unlock Hidden Cross-Sectional Predictability' (Mainak Singha, 2025). Mechanism: identify stocks with >60% positive days in trailing 63-day window (=in a drift regime), then apply SHORT-TERM REVERSAL signal exclusively to those stocks. Out-of-sample Sharpe 13+ on S&P 500 2004-2024 (suspicious but mechanism is concrete and testable). The regime gate makes intuitive sense: reversal works best on momentum-regime stocks because mean-reversion is stronger when a stock has been consistently trending. Connects to our confirmed H181 (reversal, OOS 1.138) — the regime gate could be the missing enhancement that pushes H181 to much higher Sharpe.
